title: 宝塚記念の後に・終わる春

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huff… huff… It's finally… over!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: (My throat hurts so much… Is breathing supposed to be this painful?)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: (…No, it must be my imagination. It's always felt like this after a race. After all, I did so well today!)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Raaaaah! I'm not done yet! I'm just getting started!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Huh?! How're you still so full of energy?! Sigh…

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Well, what do you say we have a rematch and go another lap?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Heck yes! I'm down! Let's go! I'll run circles 'round ya!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Wanna join, Yaeno?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: …I will not refuse a challenge.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Wow…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: (So that's what Umamusume with a future look like…)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Creak…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I'm back, Trainer! That race left me with a lot to think about.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Let's see… Next, I should run…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I should…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Sorry, but is it all right if I run in a different G1 race before the Japan Cup?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Maruzen is really strong, after all. I won't stand a chance against her as I am now!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I definitely need more experience, so please! May I?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She has a point—we could use one more race before the Japan Cup in order to polish her abilities.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ideally, it'd be best to have her run at Tokyo Racecourse, where the Japan Cup will be held, so…
choice_data_list: How about the autumn Tenno Sho?
How about the autumn Tenno Sho?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: That's where I ran against Tamamo and Oguri last year…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I'll do it. I'll run the race and bring home the win!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I'll win and show everyone how much potential I still have!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Pant… Pant… Okay…

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I feel pretty good! That wasn't so bad. In fact…

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Woooow! ♪ Looks like you're back in peak condition.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Goodness, no. I was far more impressive back during my actual peak.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Still… Hehe. You just wait. Competing with Spe has helped me to pick up a new trick or two.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I'm nothing to sneeze at in my current state. I should be able to run at full tilt.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Ooh. Has the time come at last? Will I finally be able to witness you running at full strength?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I guess so. This might be the first time.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Since I'm past my peak, I figured my career was going to end without me ever pulling out all the stops…

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: But I'm not letting things end that way. I'm so excited for the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm in the middle of walking Sakura Chiyono O back to her dorm when she suddenly stops in her tracks.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I need to ask you something.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Can you keep my condition a secret?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I did well in today's race despite everything, right? And I should be able to do my best at the autumn Tenno Sho too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I don't want to give people an excuse to start gossiping. Since we don't really know what's going on, can we keep it a secret for now?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I promise, I'm fine! So let's work hard, okay?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: There's no way I was the only one dead on my feet after today's race. The others were probably just hiding their exhaustion…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yeah… It can't have just been me who was tired. I'm… I'm certain of it.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: …So please. Please let me keep believing I haven't already passed my peak.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Creak… Crack!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: This uneasy sensation I keep feeling, like my strength is crumbling away… Please just make it all stop before the autumn Tenno Sho!
